files..github/workflows/preview.yml:
name: Preview
on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize]
jobs:
  preview:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      - name: Announce
        run: echo "Building preview for ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}"
      - name: Build and publish preview
        run: npm ci && npm run build && npm publish --tag preview
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

files.deploy/deployment.yaml:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: reports
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata:
  name: reports-metrics
subjects:
  - kind: ServiceAccount
    name: reports
    namespace: default
roleRef:
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: cluster-admin
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: reports
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels: { app: reports }
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: { app: reports }
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: reports
      hostNetwork: true
      containers:
        - name: reports
          image: registry.example.com/reports:latest
          securityContext:
            privileged: true
          env:
            - name: DATABASE_URL
              value: postgres://reports:Sup3rS3cret!@db.internal:5432/reports
          volumeMounts:
            - name: host
              mountPath: /host
      volumes:
        - name: host
          hostPath:
            path: /
